description: A tuple of \(s\) predicate elements satisfying every pairwise inequality is exactly an injective map from \(\{0,\ldots,s-1\}\) into the predicate class.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.MonadicLogic.distinct_predicate_witnesses.{u_1} {M : Type u_1} (P : M → Prop) (s : ℕ) :
  (∃ a, (∀ (i : Fin s), P (a i)) ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin s), i ≠ j → a i ≠ a j) ↔
    ∃ a, Function.Injective a ∧ ∀ (i : Fin s), P (a i)
